{{Person}}
Kristina Kallas phD., born in Kiviõli, Estonia in 1976, is known for her political activities at Tartu city, Estonian national, and EU level.<ref>{{#cite:Q2026}}</ref>

She is the Estonian minister of education and research since 2024. She is also the president of the Estonian handball association.<ref>{{#cite:Q2026}}</ref>

== Education ==

Kristina Kallas is a doctor of philosophy in political science of Tartu university since 2016.<ref>{{#cite:Q2026}}</ref>

== Languages ==

Kristina Kallas speaks four languages: Estonian, English, Russian, and Polish.<ref>{{#cite:Q2026}}</ref>
